Would you trust a call that said: buy Amazon?

Kevin explains that it is not only what you know, it is who you know. An expert can point you to something early, like a little satellite dish.

He describes a call about Jeff Bezos, a man everyone thought was starting an online bookstore. The caller said it was really a technology company. Nobody understood it. It was called Amazon.

The point: people with real knowledge often see what the crowd misses.

Who do you trust enough to listen to their advice?
